_comment: LOCAL CONFIGURATION - DO NOT COMMIT TO GIT
_comment2: Copy this file to appsettings.local.json and fill in real values
_comment3: NOTE: Autodesk ACC identifiers (HubId, ProjectId, etc.) are NOT configured here.
_comment4: They are auto-detected from API and stored in the database (source of truth).
_comment5: Set AUTODESK_CLIENT_ID and AUTODESK_CLIENT_SECRET as environment variables.

Autodesk._BootstrapAdminEmail_comment: Email of user to assign as Project Admin when creating ACC-native projects
Autodesk._OAuthRedirectPort_comment: Port for OAuth callback. MUST match APS Console Callback URL. Default: 8080
